currentContext.strengths: Diversified revenue base across three segments after FY26 - aluminium products, renewable power generation and electrical EPC - which management states is intended to strengthen the revenue base over the coming years|Long-standing sector experience on the board: Shri Lalit Kumar Daga, Non-Executive Director, is stated to have vast experience of over 60 years in the aluminium industry|Acquisition of the Elesar Focchi aluminium grills, doors and windows business brought over an existing brand together with its assets, licences, approvals, employees and a customer order book
currentContext.strategies: Diversify beyond the two legacy segments (aluminium products and renewable energy) by entering the Engineering, Procurement and Construction segment, specifically the execution of turnkey electrical sub-station projects, which management states is expected to create additional growth opportunities and strengthen the revenue base over the coming years.|Actively participate in future tenders and bidding opportunities for electrical sub-station projects to expand the turnkey EPC line of business.|Grow the aluminium segment through the acquisition of the Elesar Focchi aluminium grills, doors and windows business from Nirav Commercials Limited (a material related party transaction approved by shareholders), taken over with its assets, liabilities, licences, approvals, employees and customer orders.|Continue to explore opportunities in new business segments to diversify operations and strengthen long-term growth prospects.|Continue operating the Wind Turbine Generator and Solar Power Plant assets as a recurring revenue contributor, framed by management as a commitment to sustainable and environmentally responsible operations.|Enhance revenue generation from existing segments alongside efficient treasury management aimed at optimising returns and maximising overall profitability.
currentContext.expansion: Expansion in FY 2025-26 was through new lines of business rather than through disclosed plant capex. The Company ventured into the turnkey project business in the electrical sector and secured two Electrical Sub-Station projects aggregating 532 KV with a total contract value of Rs. 2,040.00 Lakh; approximately 55% of the project work was completed during FY 2025-26 and the balance is presently under execution, with management intending to bid for further tenders in this sector. Separately, and with shareholder approval, the Company acquired the aluminium grills, doors and windows business carried on under the brand name Elesar Focchi from Nirav Commercials Limited as a material related party transaction, on a going concern / slump sale basis, together with the related assets, liabilities, licences, approvals and employees, and took over customer orders of approximately Rs. 400.00 lakh expected to be executed during FY 2026-27. In renewable energy the Company continues to operate its existing Wind Turbine Generators and Solar Power Plants with an unchanged aggregate installed generation capacity of 2.52 MW; no capacity addition, commissioning schedule, debottlenecking programme, new plant or rupee capex quantum is disclosed anywhere in the routed text.
currentContext.mdna: Management is optimistic that the entry into electrical-sector EPC will contribute significantly to the Company's future growth, and is actively bidding for electrical sub-station projects.|Management is optimistic about the new source of revenue coming through the acquisition of the aluminium (grills, doors and windows) business.|Entry into the EPC segment is described as a strategic diversification expected to create additional growth opportunities and strengthen the revenue base over the coming years.|The acquisition is expected to strengthen the Company's presence in the aluminium segment, diversify revenue streams and contribute positively to future growth prospects.|Renewable energy segment revenue grew year on year, from Rs. 112 lakh in FY 2024-25 to Rs. 132 lakh in FY 2025-26, from an unchanged 2.52 MW of installed capacity.|No demand, pricing, raw-material or industry-cycle outlook is offered in the MD&A beyond these segment-level statements.|Two turnkey electrical sub-station projects in hand aggregating to 532 kV with a total contract value of Rs. 2,040.00 lakh; approximately 55% of the project work was completed during FY 2025-26 and the balance work is under execution.|Customer orders aggregating approximately Rs. 400.00 lakh taken over along with the acquired aluminium doors and windows business, expected to be executed during FY 2026-27.|The Company states it intends to participate in future tenders and bidding opportunities in the electrical sub-station space; no bid pipeline value is disclosed.

risks.risk: Disclaimer of opinion on internal financial controls over financial reporting
risks.note: The auditors state that the information and explanations provided by management on the system of internal financial controls over financial reporting were not complete to enable them to determine whether adequate IFC had been established or were operating effectively as at March 31, 2026. This is the single hardest disclosure in the bundle and it directly contradicts the MD&A claim of an adequate internal financial control framework and the Directors Responsibility Statement that internal financial controls are adequate and operating effectively. The auditors add that the disclaimer does not affect their opinion on the financial statements themselves.

risks.risk: Material related party transaction with a common-promoter group company
risks.note: The aluminium grills, doors and windows business under the brand Elesar Focchi was acquired from Nirav Commercials Limited, described as a group company with a common promoter / promoter group, as a material related party transaction requiring shareholder approval. A key growth initiative therefore rests on a transaction with a promoter-affiliated seller rather than an arms-length third party, which places the valuation, the transferred order book and the going-concern assumptions beyond independent market testing.

risks.risk: Two of the three business lines are new and unproven in FY 2025-26
risks.note: The Company entered the electrical EPC segment and acquired the doors and windows business in the same year. Neither has a track record inside the Company, and management frames both as the main sources of future growth, so the earnings base being underwritten by investors is largely prospective rather than demonstrated.

risks.risk: Extreme order-book concentration in the new EPC line
risks.note: The entire EPC business consists of two electrical sub-station projects in hand aggregating 532 kV with a total contract value of Rs 2,040.00 lakh, approximately 55% executed. Any delay, dispute or cost overrun on either project affects the whole segment, and continuity beyond it depends entirely on winning future tenders and bids that are not yet secured.

risks.risk: Growth depends on competitive tendering with no disclosed pipeline
risks.note: Management states it intends to actively participate in future tenders and bidding opportunities to expand this line of business. No bid pipeline, win rate, pre-qualification credential or margin expectation is disclosed, so replacement of the current order book is uncertain and price-competitive by nature.

risks.risk: Dependence on a single overseas equity-accounted associate
risks.note: The only material investee is Associated Industries Limited (SFZ) LLC, an Oman-based associate/joint venture held at 32.50% and accounted under the equity method (Form AOC-1). Consolidated outcomes are materially influenced by an entity the Company does not control, in a foreign jurisdiction, whose latest audited balance sheet is drawn to a different date (31st December, 2025) from the Company's own reporting date.

risks.risk: Sharp deterioration in liquidity cover and the introduction of borrowings
risks.note: The MD&A key-ratio disclosure shows the current ratio falling by an order of magnitude year on year and a debt-equity ratio appearing where there was none in the prior year, indicating that the Company has moved from a debt-free, cash-rich balance sheet into working-capital-intensive project and manufacturing businesses. No explanation of the significant changes accompanies the ratio table.

risks.risk: Sub-scale renewable segment and no capacity growth
risks.note: The renewable energy segment operates an unchanged aggregate installed capacity of 2.52 MW of wind turbine generators and solar plants and contributes a small revenue base. It provides steady but structurally capped earnings, and no addition, repowering plan or PPA detail is disclosed.
